name: Pierglass
description: A tall mirror in a frame: the glass mirrored, the frame the same all round.

code.style: --rule: ( @random(${shapeFrequency}) { :before { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 4%; background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-clip-path: polygon(0 0, 100% 0, 100% 100%, 0 100%, 0 92%, 92% 92%, 92% 8%, 0 8%); clip-path: polygon(0 0, 100% 0, 100% 100%, 0 100%, 0 92%, 92% 92%, 92% 8%, 0 8%); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } :after { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 18%; background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-clip-path: polygon(0 0, 100% 0, 40% 100%); clip-path: polygon(0 0, 100% 0, 40% 100%); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } @match(@x > @X / 2) { -webkit-transform: scaleX(-1); transform: scaleX(-1); } } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
